description: This file defines the Marketing report controller for the OpenCart admin panel, with methods for rendering the report view, saving settings, and fetching report data.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing reports in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the marketing report form page with necessary data and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report configuration settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the marketing report with data fetched from getReport().

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the marketing report list, delegating to getReport().

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches marketing report data, applies filters, handles pagination, and renders the report view.
